data.title: Speeding fine – €98.50, 1 point
data.summary: The Landkreis Beispielheide fine office issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) for driving 23 km/h over the limit on 21 September 2025. The total is €98.50 plus 1 point in the driving register. It was formally delivered on 17 October 2025.
data.explanation: You are accused of driving 93 km/h where 70 km/h was allowed. The fine is €70 plus a €25 fee and €3.50 costs, and you get 1 point in the Fahreignungsregister. You may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or on record with the Landkreis; the app shows the deadline, which runs from the delivery date. If you don't object, the notice becomes final and the total is due two weeks after that. Pay with the file number as reference. If unsure whether to object, consider professional legal advice.

items.title: File objection (Einspruch)
items.action: File an objection (Einspruch) in writing or on record with the Landkreis Beispielheide if you disagree.

items.action: Pay the total of €98.50 to the Landkreis, quoting the file number.
